cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Confess First
cards.instruction: Get someone else to confess or incriminate themselves before you reveal anything.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. Before I answer about the office kitchen, what happened to the printer?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Paper jam. Now, why is there smoke?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. Did you cause the jam? I need that cleared up first.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I used sticky labels. Can we talk about the smoke now?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Were they the labels marked 'not for printers'? Let's finish your statement before starting mine.

mechanism: A conducts an exacting incident interview about B printer mistake to extract incriminating detail before giving any account of A kitchen problem.
confusable: A normal investigation seeks complete facts impartially; this expert insists on finishing B culpability before starting A own statement.
comparison: Birthday alternative tests a family assurance rather than equipment use and prioritises precise attribution over technical specification.
seedUse: Office kitchen, printer and labels derive from D16-a; S03 turns questioning into precise corrections to passive descriptions.
